data.title: 史黛菈 · 烛光寝室的真丝吊带独诉
data.description: 新婚套房内烛光摇曳，纯白的大床上散落着绯红色的玫瑰花瓣。史黛菈身着轻薄修身的黑色半透吊带睡裙侧坐在床头，火红的长发披散在光洁如玉的香肩上。她微微抬眸凝望，眼角含着动人的泪光与无尽的欢欣，红唇微启，在静谧的夜色中倾诉着将一切献给心上人的崇高誓约。
data.location: luxury honeymoon master suite with white linen
data.action: sitting on white linen bed adorned with rose petals, sheer black camisole nightgown, crimson hair spread out, tear of joy gleaming in eye, blushing radiant expression looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft flickering candlelight creating warm intimate halo around figure
data.mood: transcendent romantic devotion, sacred emotional surrender
data.promptProse: Sitting on a soft white bed decorated with rose petals in flickering candlelight, Stella Vermillion wears a sheer black silk camisole. A single tear of joy catches the light on her flushed cheek as she smiles with total devotion.
data.animaCaption: Stella sitting on a candlelit bed in a sheer nightgown, tears of happiness gleaming in her eyes.
